records.name: Kuma Sushi
records.notes: Google Maps lists daily 5–10 PM at 414 Alvarado St with the same 831-324-4745 phone as Old Monterey's merchant directory. Restaurantji and Wanderlog match. The Chamber lists a different schedule (Tue–Thu 4:30–9 PM, Fri–Sat 4:30–9:30 PM and Sun 1–7 PM) and contact number. Its linked site could not be reached. Kuma's Wix menu shows no hours, Instagram requires sign-in and its ordering page shows a separate split schedule. Call 831-324-4745 to resolve the dine-in schedule. Google Maps evidence: https://www.google.com/maps/place/Sushi+Kuma/@36.5995793,-121.8946533,17z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m6!3m5!1s0x808de5ca6361c5af:0xecb2a100fa17c12f!8m2!3d36.5995793!4d-121.8946533!16s%2Fg%2F11qypjdnc2?entry=ttu&g_ep=EgoyMDI2MTEwMy4wIKXMDSoASAFQAw%3D%3D NEW 2026-11-07 source check: the restaurant-branded ordering page at https://kuma.menu11.com/monterey/order explicitly lists Monday CLOSED; Tue–Sat 11 AM–2:30 PM and 5–8 PM; Sunday 4–8 PM, under 'Hours'. This contradicts the Google Maps daily 5–10 PM listing and Chamber schedule. The ordering page also lists (831) 920-1584, different from directory (831) 324-4745. Its lunch menu states Mon–Sat 11 AM–2 PM despite the page's Monday CLOSED status. Treat the displayed schedule as ordering-platform hours, not independently verified dine-in hours; operator confirmation still needed. Do not publish.

records.name: Gelato By The Sea
records.verifiedHours: Mon–Thu 11 AM–9 PM; Fri–Sun 11 AM–10 PM
records.notes: The live Google Maps weekly hours are for 700 Cannery Row, Suite O, Monterey. The Carmel branch has a separate Maps listing with different hours. The Cannery Row property directory and Monterey County Now confirm the Suite O shop next to The Fish Hopper. MenuPix corroborates the Cannery Row address and the shared 831-869-7798 phone. Google Maps flags possible holiday exceptions.

records.name: Aquino's Birrieria & Brunch
records.verifiedHours: Regular store hours Tue–Sun 11 AM–8 PM; Mon closed. Call to confirm weekend brunch opening.
records.notes: Official Store tab at 1116A Forest Ave lists 11 AM–8 PM Tue–Sun, corroborated by Roadtrippers. The separate brunch page lists Tue–Fri 11 AM–3 PM and Sat–Sun 9 AM–3 PM, conflicting with the current Store tab on weekend opening. The homepage also advertises brunch all day. Publish regular store hours with a call-ahead note and keep exact brunch times pending.
